# BodaMoncadaVelasquez
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Luis &amp; Bessi — Nos casamos</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#E4EFFF;
    --paper-2:#E9E3D8;
    --smoke:#55697A;
    --smoke-deep:#2C3A45;
    --smoke-light:#AFC0CB;
    --brass:#3C78B1;
    --line: rgba(44,58,69,0.32);
    --line-soft: rgba(44,58,69,0.16);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:300;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .sheet{
    position:relative;
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:64px 40px;
    border-left:1px solid var(--line-soft);
    border-right:1px solid var(--line-soft);
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/100% 28px,
      var(--paper);
  }
  .sheet.dense-grid{
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/100% 28px,
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/28px 100%,
      var(--paper);
  }
  .crop{
    position:absolute;
    width:22px;
    height:22px;
    opacity:0.55;
  }
  .crop::before,.crop::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:var(--smoke-deep);}
  .crop::before{width:100%;height:1px;top:50%;}
  .crop::after{height:100%;width:1px;left:50%;}
  .crop.tl{top:22px;left:22px;}
  .crop.tr{top:22px;right:22px;}
  .crop.bl{bottom:22px;left:22px;}
  .crop.br{bottom:22px;right:22px;}

  .sheet-id{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.12em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:56px;
  }

  /* HERO */
  .hero{padding-top:40px;padding-bottom:20px;text-align:center;}
  .mark{
    width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 30px;
  }
  .eyebrow-word{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:22px;
    letter-spacing:0.28em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:0 0 18px;
  }
  .names{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-optical-sizing:auto;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(48px,10vw,84px);
    line-height:1;
    margin:0 0 22px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
  }
  .names .amp{
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:400;
    color:var(--brass);
    font-size:0.8em;
    padding:0 0.12em;
  }
  .invite-line{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    max-width:360px;
    margin:0 auto;
    line-height:1.8;
  }
  .invite-highlight{
    display:inline-block;
    margin-top:8px;
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:34px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--brass);
  }

  /* COUNTDOWN */
  .countdown{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:14px;
    margin:40px auto 0;
  }
  .cd-box{
    width:64px;
    padding:14px 0 10px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .cd-num{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:24px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    line-height:1;
  }
  .cd-label{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    color:var(--brass);
    margin-top:8px;
  }
  .cd-caption{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:16px 0 0;
  }

  /* MUSIC TOGGLE */
  .music-toggle{
    position:fixed;
    top:18px;
    right:18px;
    z-index:50;
    width:42px;
    height:42px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--paper);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(44,58,69,0.18);
  }
  .music-toggle svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--smoke-deep);}
  .music-hint{
    position:fixed;
    top:26px;
    right:66px;
    z-index:50;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    background:var(--paper);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:7px 12px;
    border-radius:16px;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(44,58,69,0.15);
    white-space:nowrap;
    animation:hint-bounce 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .music-hint svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .music-hint.hidden{display:none;}
  @keyframes hint-bounce{
    0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}
    50%{transform:translateX(-5px);}
  }
  .music-panel{
    position:fixed;
    top:68px;
    right:18px;
    z-index:50;
    width:300px;
    max-width:78vw;
    background:var(--paper);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:10px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(44,58,69,0.2);
    display:none;
  }
  .music-panel.open{display:block;}
  .music-panel p{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:0 0 8px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .music-panel iframe{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:4px;}

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .cd-box{width:52px;padding:10px 0 8px;}
    .cd-num{font-size:19px;}
  }

  /* PULSE DIMENSION DIVIDER */
  .pulse-wrap{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 40px;
    background:var(--paper);
  }
  .pulse-wrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;}

  /* PHOTO */
  .frame{
    position:relative;
    margin:46px auto;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .frame img{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:auto;
    filter: saturate(0.86) contrast(1.02);
  }
  .frame .bracket{
    position:absolute;
    width:26px;height:26px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--brass);
  }
  .frame .bracket.tl{top:-9px;left:-9px;border-right:none;border-bottom:none;}
  .frame .bracket.tr{top:-9px;right:-9px;border-left:none;border-bottom:none;}
  .frame .bracket.bl{bottom:-9px;left:-9px;border-right:none;border-top:none;}
  .frame .bracket.br{bottom:-9px;right:-9px;border-left:none;border-top:none;}
  .frame-cap{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    text-align:center;
    margin-top:14px;
  }

  .frame.wide{max-width:100%;}
  .frame.dual{
    display:flex;
    gap:18px;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .frame.dual .frame{flex:1;margin:46px 0;}

  /* SECTION TITLES */
  .section-title{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:28px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 8px;
  }
  .section-sub{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--brass);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 44px;
  }

  /* PARENTS - legend style */
  .legend{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:0;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .legend > div{
    padding:26px 22px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .legend > div:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--line);}
  .legend-key{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .legend-names{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:16.5px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
  }

  /* SITE PLAN / VENUE CARDS */
  .venue{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:34px 30px;
    margin-bottom:26px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .venue-label{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--brass);
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .venue-icon{
    width:64px;
    height:64px;
    display:block;
    margin:0 auto 18px;
  }
  .venue-name{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:24px;
    margin:0 0 6px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
  }
  .venue-loc{
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:0 0 22px;
  }
  .venue-time{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
    padding-top:14px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .map-btn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    color:var(--paper);
    background:var(--smoke-deep);
    text-decoration:none;
    padding:12px 20px;
    transition:background 0.25s ease;
  }
  .map-btn:hover{background:var(--smoke);}
  .map-btn svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0;}

  .dress{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:30px 30px 28px;
    text-align:center;
  }

  /* ITINERARY */
  .itin-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:78px 24px 1fr;
    align-items:center;
    padding:15px 0;
    border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);
  }
  .itin-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .itin-time{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
  }
  .itin-node{position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .itin-node::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:-16px;bottom:-16px;
    left:50%;
    width:1px;
    background:var(--line);
    transform:translateX(-50%);
  }
  .itin-row:first-child .itin-node::after{top:50%;}
  .itin-row:last-child .itin-node::after{bottom:50%;}
  .itin-node span{
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
    width:13px;height:13px;
    display:block;
  }
  .itin-node span::before,
  .itin-node span::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    background:var(--brass);
  }
  .itin-node span::before{width:13px;height:2.5px;top:5.25px;left:0;}
  .itin-node span::after{width:2.5px;height:13px;left:5.25px;top:0;}
  .itin-event{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    padding-left:4px;
  }

  /* CAROUSEL */
  .carousel{
    position:relative;
    max-width:460px;
    margin:0 auto 20px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .carousel-track{
    display:flex;
    transition:transform 0.45s ease;
  }
  .carousel-slide{
    min-width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:4/5;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .carousel-slide img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    display:block;
    filter:saturate(0.86) contrast(1.02);
  }
  .carousel-arrow{
    position:absolute;
    top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--paper);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(44,58,69,0.18);
  }
  .carousel-arrow svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--smoke-deep);}
  .carousel-arrow.prev{left:-16px;}
  .carousel-arrow.next{right:-16px;}
  .carousel-dots{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:8px;
    padding:14px 0 4px;
  }
  .carousel-dot{
    width:7px;height:7px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--line);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background 0.25s ease;
  }
  .carousel-dot.active{background:var(--brass);}
  @media (max-width:600px){
    .carousel-arrow.prev{left:6px;}
    .carousel-arrow.next{right:6px;}
  }

  /* GIFT NOTE */
  .gift-note{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:30px 20px;
    margin:40px 0 10px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .gift-icon{width:52px;height:52px;margin:0 auto 18px;}
  .gift-text{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:19.5px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    max-width:420px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }

  /* SCRIPTURE */
  .scripture{
    text-align:center;
    max-width:460px;
    margin:44px auto 54px;
    padding:32px 14px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .scripture-text{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.9;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    margin:0;
  }
  .scripture-ref{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:0.12em;
    color:var(--brass);
    margin:18px 0 0;
  }

  .coord{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:8px;
    right:12px;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:9px;
    color:var(--line);
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
  }

  /* FOOTER */
  .footer-sheet{text-align:center;padding-top:60px;padding-bottom:70px;}
  .footer-line{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .footer-tag{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    color:var(--brass);
  }
  .footer-note{
    margin-top:34px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--smoke);
    line-height:1.8;
  }

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .sheet{padding:44px 22px;}
    .legend{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .legend > div:first-child{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
    .venue-time{flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HERO SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid hero">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span><span class="crop bl"></span><span class="crop br"></span>
  <div class="sheet-id"><span>PLANO N.º 001 — UNIÓN</span><span>ESC. 1:1</span></div>

  <svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M50 6 L50 18 M50 84 L50 94 M6 50 L18 50 M82 50 L94 50" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M33 43 Q33 30 50 30 Q67 30 67 43 L67 47 Q50 52 33 47 Z" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="40" x2="64" y2="40" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    <path d="M50 20 L50 29 M45.5 24.5 L54.5 24.5" stroke="#3C78B1" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M14 66 L34 66 L40 55 L48 76 L54 66 L86 66" stroke="#3C78B1" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </svg>

  <p class="eyebrow-word">Nos casamos</p>
  <h1 class="names">LUIS <span class="amp">&amp;</span> BESSI</h1>
  <p class="invite-line">TE INVITAMOS A ESTE GRAN DÍA,<br><span class="invite-highlight">NUESTRA BODA</span></p>

  <div class="countdown" id="countdown">
    <div class="cd-box"><span class="cd-num" id="cd-days">00</span><span class="cd-label">Días</span></div>
    <div class="cd-box"><span class="cd-num" id="cd-hours">00</span><span class="cd-label">Horas</span></div>
    <div class="cd-box"><span class="cd-num" id="cd-mins">00</span><span class="cd-label">Min</span></div>
    <div class="cd-box"><span class="cd-num" id="cd-secs">00</span><span class="cd-label">Seg</span></div>
  </div>
  <p class="cd-caption">FALTA PARA EL 12 DE DICIEMBRE, 2026</p>
</section>

<div class="pulse-wrap">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 720 44" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <line x1="0" y1="22" x2="720" y2="22" stroke="#2C3A45" stroke-opacity="0.25" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M0 22 L280 22 L296 6 L312 38 L328 14 L344 22 L720 22" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="14" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="#2C3A45" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="720" y1="14" x2="720" y2="30" stroke="#2C3A45" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<!-- PHOTO + PARENTS SHEET -->
<section class="sheet">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span>

" alt="Luis y Bessi">
  </div>
  <p class="frame-cap">LUIS &amp; BESSI</p>

  <div class="scripture">
    <p class="scripture-text">"Más valen dos que uno,<br>
    porque obtienen más fruto de su trabajo.<br>
    Si caen, el uno levanta al otro;<br>
    pero, ¡ay del solo que cae<br>
    y no tiene quien lo levante!<br><br>
    Además, cuando dos se acuestan juntos,<br>
    se calientan mutuamente;<br>
    en cambio uno solo, ¿cómo entrará en calor?<br>
    Y si alguien puede vencer al que está solo,<br>
    dos podrán resistir juntos.<br>
    Y la cuerda de tres hilos<br>
    no se rompe fácilmente."</p>
    <p class="scripture-ref">ECLESIASTÉS 4, 9-12</p>
  </div>

  <p class="section-title">Con la bendición de DIOS</p>
  <p class="section-sub">Y NUESTROS PADRES</p>

  <div class="legend">
    <div>
      <p class="legend-key">PADRES DEL NOVIO</p>
      <p class="legend-names">JOSE MONCADA<br>Y<br>MARIA GUTIERREZ</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p class="legend-key">PADRES DE LA NOVIA</p>
      <p class="legend-names">JULIO VELAZQUES<br>Y<br>CLEMENTINA COREA</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CEREMONY / RECEPTION SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span>
  <div class="sheet-id"><span>PLANO N.º 002 — EMPLAZAMIENTO</span><span>ESC. S/E</span></div>

  <p class="section-title">El plano del día</p>
  <p class="section-sub">CEREMONIA Y RECEPCIÓN</p>

  <div class="venue">
    <svg class="venue-icon" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <line x1="20" y1="2.5" x2="20" y2="8.5" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="5" x2="23" y2="5" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <path d="M11 18 L20 9 L29 18" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="12" y="18" width="16" height="16.5" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <path d="M17.2 34.5 L17.2 26 A2.8 2.8 0 0 1 22.8 26 L22.8 34.5" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="14.5" r="1.4" fill="#3C78B1"/>
      <line x1="14.5" y1="23" x2="14.5" y2="27" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="25.5" y1="23" x2="25.5" y2="27" stroke="#55697A" stroke-width="1"/>

<script>
  // Countdown al 12 de diciembre de 2026, 3:30 p.m.
  var weddingDate = new Date("2026-12-12T15:30:00-06:00").getTime();
  function updateCountdown(){
    var now = new Date().getTime();
    var diff = weddingDate - now;
    if(diff < 0){ diff = 0; }
    var d = Math.floor(diff / (1000*60*60*24));
    var h = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60*60*24)) / (1000*60*60));
    var m = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60*60)) / (1000*60));
    var s = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60)) / 1000);
    document.getElementById('cd-days').textContent = String(d).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-hours').textContent = String(h).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-mins').textContent = String(m).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-secs').textContent = String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }
  updateCountdown();
  setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);

  // Carrusel de fotos
  (function(){
    var track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    var slides = track.children;
    var total = slides.length;
    var dotsWrap = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    var index = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<total;i++){
      var dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i===0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', (function(idx){ return function(){ goTo(idx); }; })(i));
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
    }
    function goTo(i){
      index = (i + total) % total;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (index*100) + '%)';
      var dots = dotsWrap.children;
      for(var j=0;j<dots.length;j++){ dots[j].classList.toggle('active', j===index); }
    }
    document.getElementById('carouselPrev').addEventListener('click', function(){ goTo(index-1); });
    document.getElementById('carouselNext').addEventListener('click', function(){ goTo(index+1); });

    // swipe táctil
    var startX = 0, isDown = false;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ startX = e.touches[0].clientX; isDown = true; });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', function(e){
      if(!isDown) return;
      isDown = false;
      var diff = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - startX;
      if(diff > 40) goTo(index-1);
      else if(diff < -40) goTo(index+1);
    });
  })();

  // Música — carga el video/audio oficial de YouTube solo cuando el invitado lo pide
  var toggle = document.getElementById('musicToggle');
  var panel = document.getElementById('musicPanel');
  var frame = document.getElementById('ytFrame');
  var loaded = false;
  toggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
    panel.classList.toggle('open');
    document.getElementById('musicHint').classList.add('hidden');
    if(!loaded){
      frame.src = "https://www.youtube.com/embed/06-XXOTP3Gc?autoplay=1";
      loaded = true;
    }
  });
</script>
